title: UTP Portfolio Delivery Catalogue — DIY to Government to Outpost
principle: One underlying CGX catalogue and evidence graph is rendered differently by audience, horizon and consequence; no audience receives a stronger readiness claim than the underlying item evidence supports.

offerings.name: Functional materials starter
offerings.output: guided safe coupons for structure, conductor, resistor/heater, capacitor, coil, simple sensor and optical geometry
offerings.gate: low-voltage/benign materials only unless competent supervision is present

offerings.name: CGX object starter
offerings.output: identity-tagged object with simple local sensor state and CGX helper record
offerings.gate: no claim of fully printed compute

offerings.name: Repair and custom tooling cell
offerings.output: jigs, fixtures, manifolds, tooling, housings, replacement parts, calibration artifacts

offerings.name: Functional product microfactory
offerings.output: embedded passives, sensors, comms bodies, lighting/display interfaces and hybrid compute islands

offerings.name: Cleanup-to-feed node
offerings.output: sorting/assay/water-quality/circular-feed qualification and benign local products
offerings.mode: volunteer-safe front end + professional contamination/material gate
offerings.gate: captured waste is never direct feed without identity/cleaning/characterization/coupon test

offerings.name: Circular sensor/heater network
offerings.output: repairable environmental monitoring and heating/sensing coupons using qualified recovered conductive feed
offerings.gate: ecotoxicity, emissions and recovery pathway included

offerings.name: Infrastructure sensing and functional coatings
offerings.output: road/building/guideway protective + sensing/communications layers and inspection packets
offerings.gate: mechanism must be measured; no unbounded geospatial/biofeedback/resonance claim

offerings.name: Distributed resilience microfactory
offerings.output: local spares, water/environment nodes, emergency repair, mobile printers

offerings.name: Multiphysics printable-device testbed
offerings.output: material/process sweeps, device coupons, uncertainty/falsifier datasets

offerings.name: Printer family bootstrap
offerings.output: Printer-1 → Printer-mu → parent upgrade/Printer-2 → roaming pair/team
offerings.gate: seed dependency, calibration and function-basis acceptance tracked

offerings.name: Resource-to-node bootstrap
offerings.gate: resource rights, planetary protection, mission economics and physical qualification

offerings.name: Minimum viable outpost kit
offerings.output: smallest seed set that can expand local manufacturing while remaining safely operable through latency/network loss
offerings.mode: C0/C1 local + C2 federated when available

AI_rendering.DIY: plain-language steps, required skills/tools, low-cost substitutions only when qualified, mandatory test-before-use
AI_rendering.ECO: ecological baseline, contamination gate, volunteer-safe tasks, recovery/cleanup outcomes
AI_rendering.OUTPOST: mass/energy/seed dependency, repair/reproduction closure, latency-tolerant procedures

portfolio_rule: Products/services remain federated and interoperable; Römer's moat is orchestration, evidence, systems integration and qualified process knowledge rather than mandatory ownership of every supplier or end-use.
